label_domains: 22 CIBERSORT LM22 fractions; methylation-derived leukocyte fraction; 10 RNA inflammatory or immune signatures; six BCR/TCR repertoire metrics; two mutation rates; two predicted neoantigen burdens; six genomic-context quantities; H&E-derived TIL Regional Fraction
input_processing: Selected 50 non-survival, non-subtype, non-aggregate fields; imported published values rather than recomputing them
participant_aggregation: One published participant row; endpoint-specific missing values retained
missing_or_negative_rule: Not applicable to continuous endpoints; absence from the table remained missing
analysis_transformation: Natural log of one plus the source value for silent and nonsilent mutation rates, SNV and indel neoantigens, and number of segments; all other values used as supplied

source: MC3 mutations with Bailey driver catalogue
publication_reference: Ellrott et al. 2018 and Bailey et al. 2018; doi:10.1016/j.cels.2018.03.002 and 10.1016/j.cell.2018.02.060
local_source: TCGAmutations MC3 objects; Bailey mmc1.xlsx sheet Table S1
source_identifier: 15-character TCGA Tumor Sample Barcode from MC3 clinical metadata
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01, FILTER=PASS and protein-altering missense, nonsense, nonstop, splice-site, translation-start, frameshift or in-frame variants; COADREAD drivers mapped to COAD and READ
participant_aggregation: Any qualifying variant in any matched profiled primary sample defined mutated
missing_or_negative_rule: Wild type assigned only to patients with an MC3-profiled primary tumour and no qualifying variant in that gene; patients without MC3 profiling remained missing

label_domains: Binary alteration status for ten oncogenic signalling pathways
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01 and the published pathway-level binary matrix
participant_aggregation: Any altered primary sample defined the patient-level pathway as altered
missing_or_negative_rule: Covered primary samples without the pathway alteration were negative; participants absent from the source remained missing

label_domains: Aneuploidy score, deleted-arm count, amplified-arm count and genome doubling
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01 and the published aneuploidy fields
participant_aggregation: Continuous values were averaged across primary samples; any positive primary sample defined genome doubling
missing_or_negative_rule: Participants absent from the source remained missing

local_source: fusion_mmc2.xlsx; sheets TCGA samples used in this study and Final fusion call set
label_domains: Fusion burden, any called fusion and eligible recurrent fusion-pair indicators
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01; the study sample sheet defined assay coverage and the final-call sheet defined unique fusions
participant_aggregation: Unique fusion calls were collapsed by participant
missing_or_negative_rule: Within the assayed denominator, no fusion call meant zero; participants outside the study sample list remained missing
analysis_transformation: Natural log of one plus the unique fusion count for fusion burden

publication_reference: cBioPortal TCGA PanCancer Atlas and Bonneville et al. 2017; doi:10.1200/PO.17.00073
local_source: data_clinical_sample.txt downloaded for 31 TCGA PanCancer Atlas studies
label_domains: MANTIS score, MSIsensor score and two MANTIS-based MSI-H definitions
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01 and finite MSI_SCORE_MANTIS or MSI_SENSOR_SCORE values
participant_aggregation: Finite scores were averaged across primary samples
missing_or_negative_rule: All missing primary-sample scores remained missing; MANTIS greater than 0.4 defined MSI-H in the main binary definition; the strict sensitivity used greater than 0.6 as MSI-H, less than 0.4 as MSS and excluded 0.4 to 0.6

publication_reference: UCSC Xena TCGA Pan-Cancer RNA-seq and MSigDB 2026.1.Hs
label_domains: 50 MSigDB Hallmark pathways; Reactome glutathione synthesis and recycling; Gene Ontology vitamin B6 metabolic process
input_processing: Retained primary-tumour sample type 01; standardized each measured gene within cancer; scored each set as mean standardized expression of measured member genes
participant_aggregation: Expression was averaged across multiple primary-tumour aliquots before pathway scoring
missing_or_negative_rule: Participants without a matched primary-tumour RNA sample remained missing; a pathway required at least two measured member genes
